QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredPx4MajorVersion
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Vehicles reporting a PX4 firmware major version below this value are rejected by the STRATUM compatibility gate.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required PX4 major version

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredPx4MinorVersion
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minor-version floor applied when the vehicle's PX4 major matches the required major.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required PX4 minor version

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredPx4PatchVersion
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Patch-version floor applied when the vehicle's PX4 major and minor match the required values.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required PX4 patch version

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredStratumSchemaMajor
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Required STRATUM NX schema major version
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Compatibility-gate floor for the STRATUM NX schema major reported by the vehicle. The gate requires an exact match.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required STRATUM schema major

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredStratumNxMajor
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Required STRATUM NX firmware major version
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Compatibility-gate floor for the STRATUM NX firmware major reported by the vehicle.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required STRATUM NX major

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: strictCompatibilityGate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, commands are rejected if the vehicle firmware does not meet the required versions. When disabled, mismatches are logged as warnings but commands are allowed through.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enforce compatibility gate

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: passwordHashOverride
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: SHA-256 hex of the admin password set at runtime from the admin dialog. Empty means use the compile-time hash. Do not edit by hand.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Password hash override
